usedFor: SimpleCert creates and distributes certificates, and Google Contacts saves the recipients through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each certificate recipient is saved as a contact, so their details stay in one address book.

watchOut: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert is polling, so contacts appear after a scheduled check.
